title: Disable Nagle TCP Delay
name: disable-nagle
modal: This disables packet batching (Nagle) on all network adapters for lower latency.
description: Disables Nagle packet batching to cut network delay in online games
deepDescription:
Nagle's algorithm batches small packets together, adding delay to game traffic. This disables it on every adapter:

- TcpAckFrequency → 1 (instant ACK)
- TCPNoDelay → 1 (no batching)

Revert removes both values. Slightly higher packet count.
